scientific_integrity: The initial-segment encoding and underlying Oddtown upper bound are credited as known deductions. A complete deterministic clique enumeration supplies finite exactness; the all-n lower bound is justified by a direct block construction. No priority or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact for orders one through five only; arbitrary-order statements are bounds. The six-coordinate optimum and exact asymptotic growth remain unresolved.
title: Oddtown families of two-bounded multisets: the first excess and a six-coordinate amplifier
